newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-FAI says exits health insurance.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-FAI says exits health insurance.

text.p: FAI Insurances Ltd said on Tuesday it had sold its wholly-owned health insurance unit, FAI Health Benefits Ltd, to the Grand United Friendly Society, at a marginal profit over book value.

In a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange, FAI said that while it was reluctant to sell out of the sector, it was impossible to post an acceptable return to its shareholders while the health insurance industry was in desperate need of reform.
FAI said rates needed to increase significantly and the reinsurance equalisation Trust needed to be overhauled.
The industry was chronically inefficient and the Federal Government did not intend to make any changes until its second term of office, FAI said.
By 3.30 p.m. (0430 GMT), FAI shares were two cents higher at 70 cents on turnover of 134,990 shares.
